fuente.titulo: Bill Gates: Technology is a world in need of governance

titular: Bill Gates: AI needs government oversight, not self-rule
bajada: In a Vatican News interview, Gates urges harnessing AI for health, education and farming
caption: Bill Gates told Vatican News that artificial intelligence cannot regulate itself and must be guided by governments, while highlighting its potential to improve healthcare, education and agriculture. Source: Vatican News, Oct 13, 2026.
